نتواثب (form VI)
# نَتَوَاثَبُ (natawāṯabu) /na.ta.waː.θa.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَاثَبَ (tawāṯaba)
# نَتَوَاثَبَ (natawāṯaba) /na.ta.waː.θa.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَاثَبَ (tawāṯaba)
# نَتَوَاثَبْ (natawāṯab) /na.ta.waː.θab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَاثَبَ (tawāṯaba)
